scenes: He borrowed one billion dollars... to vote himself the money.
April twenty twenty-two. Beanstalk, a crypto stablecoin project. Its rule: whoever holds the most votes decides.
An attacker posts a proposal. It looks like a donation to Ukraine.
In one single transaction, he borrows about one billion dollars. A flash loan, from Ah-vay and others.
A flash loan is money you borrow and repay in the same transaction. No credit check. No collateral.
He uses it to buy voting power. Votes yes on his own proposal. But hidden inside is code that sends him the project's money.
one hundred eighty-one million dollars, drained.
He pays the loan back in the same transaction. He walks away with about seventy-six million.
And the Ukraine part? He really did send two hundred fifty thousand dollars.
If votes can be borrowed, the vote can be bought. Follow Chain Secrets.
